# Test green ball UP boundary: move UP 5 times, track position each step
def ballpos(fr, color='N'):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']==color and n['pixels']==4:
            b=n['boundary']
            rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            return (min(rows),min(cols))
    return None
print("start:", ballpos(current_frame))
res=action(['UP','UP','UP','UP','UP'])
print("after 5 UP:", ballpos(current_frame))
# also check if any other node changed (block/house)
import collections
def sig(fr):
    d=collections.Counter()
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['pixels']>=16:
            d[(n['color'],n['pixels'])]+=1
    return dict(d)
print("big nodes now:", sig(current_frame))
